tasks.subject: Task 4: Add renderer.Lower dispatch for core subset
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Introduce `renderer.Lower(ctx LoweringCtx, node logical.Node) → (RenderedQuery, error)` with type-switch. Phase 1 dispatches LeafExprPlan, ScalarLiteralPlan, and BinaryPlan (scalar-only) through the new path. Unsupported kinds return errUnsupportedLowerNode; service.go falls back hierarchically (whole-query) to Fragment.

**Files:**
- Create: `internal/promshim/native/renderer/lower.go`, `renderer/lower_test.go`
- Modify: `internal/promshim/native/renderer/source.go`, `internal/promshim/service.go`

**Verify:** `go test ./internal/promshim/native/renderer/ -run TestLower && scripts/run-compliance.sh && scripts/run-bench.sh --matrix`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/promshim/native/renderer/lower.go", "internal/promshim/native/renderer/lower_test.go", "internal/promshim/service.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./internal/promshim/native/renderer/ -run TestLower && scripts/run-compliance.sh && scripts/run-bench.sh --matrix", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Lower dispatches via type switch", "Per-kind lowering functions are pure given ctx", "Hierarchical split: Lower or Fragment for whole query, never mixed", "Byte-identical SQL for the three supported kinds", "Unsupported-kind test asserts sentinel + fallback", "Compliance 538/539; bench ±3%"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Port remaining renderer surfaces; retire NativeFragment
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Port every remaining PromQL surface from RenderFragment to Lower dispatch, one surface per commit. Each commit: replace lowering body with direct emit/ + storage/ calls, migrate substring tests → golden-SQL, delete the Fragment-producing analysis branch. When every surface is ported, delete NativeFragment, BuildFragment, native.Analyze, and all Fragment types.

**Surface order (one commit per):** SyntheticSeries, ScalarConvert, Subquery, SortTransform, LabelTransform, ClampTransform, RangeFunction, Aggregation, HistogramProjection, HistogramFunction, Absent, InfoJoin, BinaryVectorJoin, ValueTransform. Final commit deletes NativeFragment.

**Files (final commit):**
- Delete: `internal/promshim/native/builder.go`, `native/analysis*.go`, `native/types.go` Fragment types
- Keep/move: `native/sqlb/`, `native/renderer/*` (reorganized by node kind)

**Verify:** `go test ./internal/promshim/... && scripts/run-compliance.sh && scripts/run-bench.sh --matrix --long-range all && ! grep -r 'NativeFragment\|sqlb.RawLit' internal/promshim/native/renderer/ --include='*.go'`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["internal/promshim/native/renderer/lower_*.go", "internal/promshim/native/renderer/testdata/", "internal/promshim/native/"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./internal/promshim/... && scripts/run-compliance.sh && scripts/run-bench.sh --matrix", "acceptanceCriteria": ["No NativeFragment references in non-test code", "No sqlb.RawLit in native/renderer/", "Every lowering dispatches on logical.Node + reads logical.Analysis", "Golden-SQL tests cover every PromQL shape", "Compliance 538/539", "Bench ±5% per-query, no systematic regression", "Long-range bench (7d/30d/1y) green"]}
```
